**Table 24 (Three-way ANOVA)** — FILLED. Key findings:
- Depth-Pair dominates (F=22738, η²\_p=.997)
- Generator is large (F=852, η²\_p=.866)
- Scorer is significant (F=17.5, p<.001) but small effect (η²\_p=.166)
